name: Moria Scavenger
oracle_text:
Deathtouch, haste
{T}, Discard a card: Draw a card. If the discarded card was a creature card, amass Orcs 1. (Put a +1/+1 counter on an Army you control. It's also an Orc. If you don't control an Army, create a 0/0 black Orc Army creature token first.)
blocked_sentences: {T}, Discard a card: Draw a card. If the discarded card was a creature card, amass Orcs 1

needs.what: an `as` key on the `discard` cost (as `tap_permanents`, `sacrifice` and `exile_from_graveyard` already carry) that binds the card discarded to pay the cost, so the ability's effects can test it with an `if` on `exists` over `{"binding": <name>, "types": ["Creature"]}` ("If the discarded card was a creature card")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `discard` cost (with `discard_selector`) pays through `costs._discard` and writes nothing into `bindings`; only tap_permanents, sacrifice, return_to_hand and exile_from_graveyard name what paid them. Moving the discard into the `discard` op (which does take `as`) would pay at resolution, letting the ability be activated with an empty hand. Conditioning on `discard_selector` would make two abilities and change what may be discarded. `amass` with `subtype: Orc` and the `orc_army_0_0_b` token are otherwise available.
